name: Balanced
description: No special orders. Steady fire across every range.

name: Long-Range Barrage
description: Open with everything that reaches. Missiles and lasers hit harder; kinetics suffer. Strong against Close Assault.

name: Close Assault
description: Charge to point-blank range. Kinetics and accuracy improve, but the fleet takes more damage. Strong against Evasive Manoeuvres.

name: Evasive Manoeuvres
description: Scatter and weave. Enemy accuracy drops sharply at the cost of your own firepower. Strong against Shield Wall.

name: Shield Wall
description: Divert power to deflectors. Shields absorb far more; damage output falls. Strong against Long-Range Barrage.
